description: This file contains a unit test class named 'ImageAspectRatioTest' that tests the validation of image aspect ratios using the 'ImageAspectRatio' validation rule within the OrangeHRM project. It includes a data provider for different test cases and uses PHPUnit-style assertions.

classes.name: ImageAspectRatioTest
classes.description: A test class extending TestCase that verifies the behavior of the ImageAspectRatio validation rule with various aspect ratio inputs.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Tests validation of image aspect ratio using different dataset inputs, asserting true or false based on the expected validity.

methods.name: dataProvider
methods.description: Provides a set of test cases with aspect ratio, file information, and expected validation result (true/false).
